setp.pattern.notes: BHM candidates take 2 extra sections (Service Aptitude, Scientific Aptitude) in 3 hours. The 2026 prospectus lists 40 + 30 + 30 + 30 = 130 questions in 2 hours.

setp.elig.note: The NTA bulletin sets no minimum %. The 60% rule (55% for SC/ST/PwD) is reported for IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu admissions; confirm on their sites.
